_notes: Bucket B: CF CREW C owns day -7 (C, not the TC's B: B specs 3426/2906/3184 read piece-job warnings/amounts that an employee rate would move). Analyze only.
4 cards = CF C TWO Time In 07:00, piece-outs 09:00 x3 and 10:00 x2 (Transfer > New record > Add Piece-out), Time Out 11:00, on CF PIECE JOB (no hourly rate; read-only on a Piece job's form).

warn.zero_rate fires only when Job.HourlyRate and Employee.Rate are both 0. The rate is set on Setup > Employee (input#rate) only when missing and restored on screen at the end; the teardown PUT is the backstop.

annotations.description: The preview grid has no Hourly Rate column (measured 2026-11-11, fixed headers, no column picker). The rate is proven as Amount / Net Time = the employee's rate on a piece job whose pieces (5 x 1) cannot reach that pay on their own (dev showed Net 4, Amount 60.00 at rate 15).
Job Cards preview banner warnings (e.g. a zero-amount 10:00-11:00 segment) are not the TC's Warnings count.
